articles.description: Eleven people, including two Indian nationals, were injured after one of the towers of the Financial Centre in Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh, was targeted in an attack allegedly carried out by Yemen's Houthis, the Saudi Civil Defence said on Tuesday.
